summary.zh: 宾语从句是名词性从句的一种，在句中充当动词、介词或某些形容词后的宾语。它常由 that, whether, if, what, why, how, when, where, who 等连接词引导。对于准备 PTE Academic 和 IELTS 的中国考生来说，宾语从句非常重要，因为它可以帮助考生在写作和口语中表达观点、转述信息、解释原因、描述研究发现，并提高句子复杂度。掌握宾语从句时，需要特别注意陈述语序、时态一致、连接词选择以及间接疑问句的结构。

structure.formula: 主语 + 谓语动词 / 形容词 / 介词 + 连接词 + 主语 + 谓语 + 其他成分
structure.explanation: 宾语从句在主句中充当宾语，通常放在动词之后，例如 believe, think, suggest, indicate, explain, demonstrate, assume, argue 等。在学术英语中，宾语从句常用于表达研究结论、作者观点或数据说明。宾语从句内部必须使用陈述语序，即“连接词 + 主语 + 谓语”，不能使用疑问语序。例如，应说 I do not know why this trend occurred，而不是 I do not know why did this trend occur。that 引导的宾语从句主要陈述事实或观点；whether 和 if 表示“是否”；wh- 连接词用于引导包含具体疑问信息的宾语从句。

examples.en: Researchers believe that early intervention can improve learning outcomes.
examples.zh: 研究人员认为，早期干预可以改善学习结果。

examples.en: The survey shows that many students prefer flexible learning schedules.
examples.zh: 调查显示，许多学生更喜欢灵活的学习时间安排。

examples.en: Many people wonder whether artificial intelligence will replace certain jobs.
examples.zh: 许多人想知道人工智能是否会取代某些工作。

examples.en: The lecturer explained why renewable energy has become more affordable.
examples.zh: 讲师解释了为什么可再生能源变得更加便宜。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达观点和判断
usage_scenarios.description: 宾语从句常用于 think, believe, argue, assume, claim, suggest 等动词之后，用来表达个人观点、学术判断或论证立场。在 IELTS Writing Task 2 和 PTE Essay 中，这类结构可以使观点表达更自然、更正式。

examples.en: I believe that governments should invest more in public transportation.
examples.zh: 我认为政府应该在公共交通方面投入更多资金。

examples.en: Some experts argue that online education can reduce educational inequality.
examples.zh: 一些专家认为，在线教育可以减少教育不平等。

examples.en: It is widely assumed that economic growth depends partly on technological innovation.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为，经济增长在一定程度上依赖技术创新。

usage_scenarios.title: 转述信息和研究发现
usage_scenarios.description: 在学术写作和听力复述中，宾语从句可用于报告研究、讲座、图表或文章中的信息。常见动词包括 show, indicate, reveal, suggest, demonstrate, report, find 等。

examples.en: The data indicate that household energy consumption has declined over the past decade.
examples.zh: 数据显示，过去十年家庭能源消耗已经下降。

examples.en: The study found that regular exercise may reduce stress levels among university students.
examples.zh: 该研究发现，规律锻炼可能降低大学生的压力水平。

examples.en: The graph shows that the number of international students increased steadily.
examples.zh: 图表显示，国际学生人数稳步增加。

usage_scenarios.title: 构成间接疑问句
usage_scenarios.description: 当一个疑问句作为宾语放入另一个句子时，就形成间接疑问句。间接疑问句必须使用陈述语序，而不是疑问语序。这一点是中国考生在 PTE Speaking 和 IELTS Speaking 中的高频错误点。

examples.en: Could you explain how this policy affects low-income families?
examples.zh: 你能解释这项政策如何影响低收入家庭吗？

examples.en: The professor asked whether the students had understood the main argument.
examples.zh: 教授询问学生是否理解了主要论点。

examples.en: I am not sure why the experiment produced different results.
examples.zh: 我不确定为什么这个实验产生了不同的结果。

usage_scenarios.title: 表达不确定性和评价
usage_scenarios.description: 宾语从句可以放在 be certain, be aware, be concerned, be convinced, be interested 等形容词结构之后，用于表达确定性、意识、担忧或兴趣。在正式写作中，这类结构有助于增强语义层次。

examples.en: Many parents are concerned that excessive screen time may affect children's concentration.
examples.zh: 许多家长担心，过度使用屏幕可能影响儿童的注意力。

examples.en: Policy makers are aware that climate change requires long-term cooperation.
examples.zh: 政策制定者意识到，气候变化需要长期合作。

examples.en: Researchers are interested in how social media influences political participation.
examples.zh: 研究人员对社交媒体如何影响政治参与感兴趣。

common_mistakes.wrong: I don't know why did he choose this method.
common_mistakes.correct: I don't know why he chose this method.
common_mistakes.explanation: 宾语从句中的间接疑问句必须使用陈述语序。“why he chose this method”才是正确结构，不能保留疑问句中的助动词倒装“did he choose”。

common_mistakes.wrong: The report shows the unemployment rate increased.
common_mistakes.correct: The report shows that the unemployment rate increased.
common_mistakes.explanation: 在非正式英语中 that 有时可以省略，但在学术写作中，尤其是句子较长或信息较复杂时，保留 that 可以让结构更清晰。PTE 和 IELTS 写作中建议优先使用清楚完整的表达。

common_mistakes.wrong: I am agree that education is important.
common_mistakes.correct: I agree that education is important.
common_mistakes.explanation: agree 是动词，不能与 be 动词连用。中国学习者常受中文“我是同意的”影响而误写为 am agree。正确表达是“I agree that...”。

common_mistakes.wrong: She asked that whether the results were reliable.
common_mistakes.correct: She asked whether the results were reliable.
common_mistakes.explanation: that 和 whether 通常不能同时引导同一个宾语从句。whether 本身已经表示“是否”，不需要再加 that。

common_mistakes.wrong: Many people believe that technology will improves education.
common_mistakes.correct: Many people believe that technology will improve education.
common_mistakes.explanation: 情态动词 will 后必须接动词原形。宾语从句中虽然有独立的主语和谓语，但仍然要遵守基本动词形式规则。

common_mistakes.wrong: He said that he is tired yesterday.
common_mistakes.correct: He said that he was tired yesterday.
common_mistakes.explanation: 当主句谓语是过去时 said，且从句描述的是过去当时的状态时，从句通常也要使用过去时。这属于宾语从句中的时态一致问题。

common_mistakes.wrong: The lecturer mentioned about that the population was aging.
common_mistakes.correct: The lecturer mentioned that the population was aging.
common_mistakes.explanation: mention 是及物动词，后面可以直接接宾语或宾语从句，不需要加 about。可以说 talked about that issue，但不能说 mentioned about that。

pte_usage.description: 宾语从句在 PTE Academic 中非常常见，尤其出现在 Summarize Written Text, Write Essay, Retell Lecture, Summarize Spoken Text 和 Answer Short Question 的答案组织中。考生需要用宾语从句准确转述文本或讲座信息，例如 The speaker explains that..., The passage suggests that..., The research indicates that...。在口语部分，宾语从句可以帮助考生避免句子过短，提高语法复杂度；在写作部分，它可以帮助表达因果、观点、发现和不确定性。需要注意的是，PTE 评分重视 grammatical range and accuracy，因此宾语从句应保持语序正确、连接词准确、时态一致。
sections: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks

academic_patterns.pattern: It can be argued that + clause.
Policy makers should consider whether + clause.
academic_patterns.translation: 政策制定者应该考虑是否……

ai_tips: 写作中如果需要表达观点，可以优先使用“I believe that...”“It can be argued that...”“The evidence suggests that...”等结构，比简单句更符合学术表达。
遇到 why, how, where, when 引导的宾语从句时，先检查语序是否为“连接词 + 主语 + 谓语”，不要使用疑问句倒装。
在 PTE Summarize Written Text 中，宾语从句适合用来整合原文核心信息，例如“The passage explains that...”或“The author suggests that...”。
如果主句是过去时，转述内容通常需要注意时态后移，但客观真理、科学事实或仍然成立的事实可以保持一般现在时。
that 引导的宾语从句在口语中可省略，但在正式写作中保留 that 往往能提升句子清晰度。

practice_questions.question: 改正句子：I don't know where does she live.
practice_questions.answer: I don't know where she lives. 解释：宾语从句要使用陈述语序，即 where + 主语 + 谓语。

practice_questions.question: 用宾语从句翻译：许多专家认为，城市化会影响住房价格。
practice_questions.answer: Many experts believe that urbanization can affect housing prices.

practice_questions.question: 选择正确句子：A. The study indicates that sleep affects memory. B. The study indicates that does sleep affect memory.
practice_questions.answer: A。解释：that 引导的宾语从句使用陈述语序，不能使用疑问语序。

practice_questions.question: 将直接疑问句改为宾语从句：Why did the company change its policy? → The journalist asked...
practice_questions.answer: The journalist asked why the company changed its policy.

practice_questions.question: 用 whether 完成句子：Policy makers should consider ______ public transport is affordable for low-income groups.
practice_questions.answer: Policy makers should consider whether public transport is affordable for low-income groups.

practice_questions.question: 改正句子：The lecturer mentioned about that climate change affects agriculture.
practice_questions.answer: The lecturer mentioned that climate change affects agriculture. 解释：mention 是及物动词，后面不需要 about。

practice_questions.question: 用 academic pattern 造句，表达“数据表明网络购物越来越受欢迎”。
practice_questions.answer: The data indicate that online shopping is becoming increasingly popular.

practice_questions.question: 判断是否正确：I wonder whether will technology replace teachers.
practice_questions.answer: 不正确。正确句子是：I wonder whether technology will replace teachers. 解释：whether 引导的宾语从句中，will 应放在主语 technology 后面。
